items.title: How AI Is Used by Netflix at Its VFX Eyeline Studios, Revealed by VP Mohsen Mousavi at View Conference
items.excerpt: Eyeline VP Mohsen Mousavi reveals how Netflix uses AI for crowds, sets and relighting, while developing new tools for filmmaking.

items.title: An AI-Generated Trailer Won the Inaugural $2.5 Million Future Vision XPRIZE — and Its Director Hopes It'll Change Minds About AI
items.excerpt: "Jeff Synthesized" took home the $2.5 million Future Vision XPRIZE with the AI-generated proof-of-concept trailer for "The Gifted."

items.title: 'IvyBears' Hits Cannes After YouTube Breakout, Spawns Animated Feature Project (EXCLUSIVE)
items.excerpt: From consumer products to character-driven series, IvyBears goes brand-to-content in a 'reverse flywheel' approach powered by AI and artists alike, now spawning an animated feature.

items.title: AI Tools Bring Efficiencies But Have Limitations, Says Weta CTO Kimball Thurston: "Tech Companies Should Collaborate More With Creatives"
items.excerpt: Weta FX CTO Kimball Thurston, Korean filmmaker Kang Yun-sung and Netflix's Sung Q Lee discussed the advantages and limitations of using AI tools in production workflows.

items.title: We Will Never "Lie To The Audience" Over Artificial Intelligence, Says BBC Content Chief Kate Phillips
items.excerpt: At MIPCOM, BBC content chief Kate Phillips set out the broadcaster's line on AI-made content, after DG Matt Brittin said an AI-generated 'Doctor Who' episode he was sent was "pretty good."

items.title: ACFM Chief Ellen YD Kim Talks AI Development; Korean Recovery; Market Spotlights On Thailand & Japan
items.excerpt: The head of Busan's Asian Contents & Film Market discusses how AI development is being folded into the market alongside Korean cinema's 2026 recovery.

items.title: Sync.Labs Intros Zero-Shot Lipsyncing for Film and Television
items.excerpt: Sync.Labs launched Sync.Productions, bringing its studio-grade zero-shot AI lipsync technology to film and television production for dubbing and dialogue fixes.

items.title: Ambassadors' In-House AI Workflow Platform Available to All
items.excerpt: Amsterdam-based creative production company Ambassadors has made Mosa, its in-house visual AI workflow platform, available to all.

items.title: Reallusion and Escape.AI Partner to Solve AI Video Bottlenecks and Expand Distribution
items.excerpt: A strategic alliance connects Reallusion's 3D character/animation ecosystem with John Gaeta's Escape.AI Neo Cinema platform to tackle control bottlenecks in AI video and widen distribution.

items.title: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10
items.excerpt: Higgsfield brings creators longer videos - from one minute to over ten - with GPT-6 Astra, precise visuals with GPT-Image-2.5, and a path to voice filmmaking with GPT-Live.

items.title: MIPCOM: 'Journey to the West - The Lost Five Hundred Years' First Look Revealed by Utopai & Huace
items.excerpt: Utopai Studios and Huace revealed a first look at 'Journey to the West - The Lost Five Hundred Years,' a fully AI-generated prequel series inspired by the classic Chinese novel.

items.title: RevThink's Revolve Accelerator Explores What Clients Value in the Age of AI
items.excerpt: RevThink's six-week program for motion design studio owners, starting October 13, explores how AI changes creative expertise and what clients value.

items.title: Aaron Sorkin Explains What AI Gets Wrong About Storytelling
items.excerpt: In a wide-ranging interview, Aaron Sorkin explains where AI falls short as a storytelling and screenwriting tool.

items.title: The Next Generation Speaks: What Young VFX Artists Are Doing Differently
items.excerpt: Gen Z VFX artists split on AI - some denounce generative AI, others tout traditional AI's efficiency - as they reshape studio workflows and careers.

items.title: It's 'incomprehensible' that Instagram allowed an AI image of Mia Goth to spread, say her reps
items.excerpt: Mia Goth's representatives say they filed multiple complaints with Instagram about a fan account posting AI-generated images of the actor - a fresh flashpoint over performer likeness.

items.title: Call for Participation: USC Annenberg AI in Film and TV Survey
items.excerpt: Dr. Stacy L. Smith's Inclusion Initiative asks above- and below-the-line film and TV professionals to share how they view and use AI in an anonymous survey.
